scope: Source and fixed target inspection only. No candidate approval and no editor proposals read.

provenance.targetReferences: The existing E ImageGen target used the actual E source snapshot and plant style reference only. The approved N native image/settings were supplied afterward as the family continuity contract; they were not an input to that earlier generation.
provenance.familyApprovalScope: Approved N native materials, section profiles, phase, capture and runtime consumer are continuity references. They do not approve E.

scores.context: Comparative baseline observations for the original only; these are not approval thresholds.

sourceObservations: The original is immediately recognizable as a straight modular conveyor: a slate deck between coral rails, raised on wooden legs. The source silhouette and strong palette separation already support recognition at cell sizes 128, 55 and 32.

At full size, the broad coral rail faces read as flat rectangular strips, with abrupt dark lower bands. The wooden legs are almost black on a dark background and merge with the underside rather than communicating warm wood. The deck uses narrow hard phase bands with little material or rounded slat volume.

All 96 original samples were inspected in four verified 24-frame contact sheets. The deck bands move while rails and supports remain stationary; no geometry deformation is intended. N/S show the screen-horizontal flow axis and E/W the screen-vertical flow axis. The original 24 frames are unique for each facing.

The original support count, rail part count and blank surfaces are not design requirements. A native rebuild with clearer construction, proportions, softened forms and purposeful accents is welcome inside the functional envelope.
targetObservations: The target calls for warm, softly lit cartoon construction: a peach-coral rail shoulder with a broad controlled highlight and rounded edge response; a cooler slate deck with soft slat shoulders; honey-colored supports with restrained grain and small gold fasteners.

Its useful contribution is crafted volume and material distinction, not a mandate for gloss, exact bolt counts, exact support proportions or pixel identity. The approved native N image establishes the actual family material and connector appearance that E must meet.

The target's enlarged gold end collars, isolated terminal treatment and altered framing cannot override straight-module join planes, source ports or registration. It also contains faint low-alpha stray pixels outside the visible object; those are ImageGen artifacts, not desired export content.
Only one source-facing target exists. Unseen facings must preserve coherent native construction and the same family style without inventing extra target views.

actualSourceContract.inspection: The exact original .blend was opened read-only in Blender 5.2.2 LTS. The E collection was linked into an isolated scene and its global viewport/render hiding was disabled in memory before evaluated measurements. No original file was saved.
actualSourceContract.deckSourceSection: Deck is a plane at z=.64, width .70; native longitudinal endpoints are +/- .5. Rails occupy cross-width .35..48 on each side, z=.505..695. Preserve the compatible native family section/connection envelope, not the incidental source box topology.
actualSourceContract.motion: Actual native action evaluated at frames 1..25 for all four facings: phase=-7*(frame-1)/24, 24 unique samples at 12fps, closing value -7 at frame25. Evaluated topology is static across every sample. UV.x is incoming0 to outgoing1; seven periods per cell.
actualSourceContract.registeredCapture: 55.00798-degree square top/front oblique camera, pixel aspect 1.22065556:1, 384x704 sourceScale2 frame, logical192x352, logical root96,248, 128 logical pixels/cell. Measured source-scale2 root192,496.00003; one world X/depth unit256 px, height unit179.20008 px upward.
actualSourceContract.atlases: Every facing retains a 6x4 atlas of 2304x2816 pixels, with the original 24 384x704 rects in original order. Closure is evidence only, not an extra runtime frame.

sourceCaveats: The library starts with a presentation camera and hidden E collection. Those saved visibility/camera values are not the registered export contract. The recorded 55.00798-degree camera, not the incidental 35-degree presentation, governs review.

A hidden collection yields stale identity world matrices and a stale phase even after changing the root. Measurements were repeated after unhiding the collection; only the corrected evaluated report is used.

The camera/asset source records describe historical captureScale4, while the catalog and refinement outputs use sourceScale2. Preserve the logical frame/root and accurately recalibrate source-scale2 metadata.

N's intrinsic orientation is pi; E's is pi/2. Do not copy N's intrinsic orientation or port labels unchanged. Compatible same-flow N-reference facings are E:S with N:W, E:N with N:E, E:E with N:S, and E:W with N:N.

A source sprite's UV phase and a visually plausible standalone frame do not prove seamless assemblies. E needs new native-versus-independent RGB and alpha evidence through the approved Godot consumer, including mixed compatible joins and fractional contexts.
The source-size sheet in reviews is an analysis aid made with Pillow, not evidence of Godot filtering. Native and runtime checks remain required for the candidate.
rankedDesiredOutcomes: Show the approved family's warm coral/slate/honey material vocabulary with softer rail and slat volume, legible structure and useful native craft detail inside the locked envelope.
Keep every facing and animation phase clean and readable at128,55,32: no black support dead spots, texture swimming, noisy pinpoints, broken cut edges or disappearing functional forms.
Prove the exact E orientation, all96 native frames plus closure, original atlas layout and seamless repeated/mixed compatible joins in both RGB and alpha through the approved Godot consumer.
